{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the first years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] '''massacred''' a group of shopkeepers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]] after they opposed Imperial taxes. [[Ran Niall]], then a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], was horrified by the massacre, and deserted soon after.<ref name="OAA1">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>
